title: Tekneye Varış
description: Kalamış Marina'ya ulaşıldı. Tekne kontrolü başlıyor.

title: Motor Bakımı Başladı
description: Motor yağı boşaltıldı, filtreler değiştirildi. Antifreeze sisteme eklendi.

title: Kış Hazırlığı Tamamlandı
description: Tüm işlemler başarıyla tamamlandı. Tekne kış örtüsü kapatıldı.

title: Fenerbahçe Marina'ya Varış
description: Tekneye ulaşıldı. İlk görsel inceleme yapılıyor.

title: Motor İncelemesi Başladı
description: Starboard motora erişim sağlandı. Titreşim kaynağı araştırılıyor.

title: Ek Sorun Tespit Edildi
description: Titreşim damperi yanı sıra egzoz bağlantısında gevşeme tespit edildi. Ek malzeme gerekiyor.

title: Göcek Marina'ya Varış
description: Tekneye erişim sağlandı.

title: Elektrik Panosu Söküldü
description: Eski pano söküldü, kablo tespiti yapıldı. Yeni malzeme kurulumuna başlandı.

title: Elektrik Sistemi Tamamlandı
description: Yeni pano monte edildi, tüm devreler test edildi. Sistem nominal çalışıyor.

title: Çeşme Marina'ya Varış
description: Tekneye ulaşıldı. Yıllık bakım başlıyor.

title: Motor Bakımı Yapılıyor
description: Yağ, filtreler ve kanallar değiştirildi. Soğutma sistemi test edildi.

title: Rutin Bakım Tamamlandı
description: Tüm bakım işlemleri tamamlandı. Motor test koşusu yapıldı, normal çalışıyor.

title: Ataköy Marina'ya Varış
description: CargoDry demo teknesi inceleniyor.

title: Nem Analizi Başladı
description: Kabin içi nem ölçümleri alınıyor. Kritik noktalar tespit edildi.

title: Ek Malzeme Gerekiyor
description: Beklenenin üzerinde nem tespit edildi. Ek nem giderici ünite ve sealant malzeme gerekiyor. Temin için 1-2 gün bekleniyor.

title: Arrived at Marina di Portofino
description: Team arrived at berth 14A. Engine room access confirmed with captain. Initial walk-through complete. Port engine located aft of midship compartment.

title: Engine Room Diagnostic Started
description: Full diagnostic commenced. Data logger connected to port engine ECU. Vibration readings taken at idle, 1,800 RPM and 2,200 RPM. Anomalous harmonics confirmed above 2,100 RPM consistent with crankshaft bearing wear.

title: Crankshaft Bearing Wear Confirmed
description: Diagnostic complete. Bearing on cylinders 3 and 4 shows 0.08mm wear beyond OEM tolerance of 0.05mm. MAN Diesel OEM replacement set ordered — ETA 3 business days from Hamburg depot.

title: Diagnostic Phase Complete — Disassembly Authorised
description: Full diagnostic report submitted to owner and signed off. Phase transition: Diagnostics → Disassembly. Engine mounts unbolted from stringers. Sump and oil cooler lines drained and captured for disposal.

title: Disassembly Phase Started
description: Port engine sump removed. Bearing caps extracted on cylinders 1-4. Cylinder 3 and 4 main bearing journals show visible scoring requiring light polish before new bearing fitment. Cylinder 1 and 2 within tolerance.

title: Photo Documentation — Bearing Scoring
description: Photographic record uploaded: cylinder 3 journal scoring (ref: IMG-SR9001-003), cylinder 4 journal scoring (ref: IMG-SR9001-004), removed bearing shells showing wear pattern on thrust faces. Copies forwarded to owner.

title: Replacement Parts Arrived
description: MAN Diesel OEM bearing set arrived from Hamburg. Part numbers verified against engine serial plate. All components inspected and within specification. Crankshaft polishing on cylinders 3 and 4 completed by in-house machinist.

title: Bearing Replacement Phase Started
description: Phase transition: Disassembly → Parts Replacement. New OEM bearings installed on cylinders 3 and 4. Torque applied per MAN spec: stage 1 at 80 Nm, stage 2 at 160 Nm, final angle torque 90 degrees. Sump gasket replaced.

title: Photo Documentation — Bearing Replacement
description: Photographic record: new bearings in situ (ref: IMG-SR9001-008), torque wrench confirmation (ref: IMG-SR9001-009), sump reinstallation complete (ref: IMG-SR9001-010). Oil system flushed and refilled with Castrol TLX Plus 15W-40.

title: System Testing in Progress — Sea Trial Scheduled
description: Engine started for warm-up run. Idle vibration nominal. Test run to 1,800 RPM — no anomalous harmonics detected. Full-load sea trial scheduled for 11 July at 09:00 with owner attendance requested.

title: Arrived at Göcek Marina
description: Team arrived at Göcek Breeze haul-out bay. Initial hull inspection performed before travel lift. No visible impact damage. Vessel confirmed ready for lift.

title: Hull Inspection Started Post Haul-Out
description: Vessel lifted at 10:30. Full hull inspection underway. Antifouling paint heavily fouled — barnacle coverage approximately 40% below waterline. Epoxy substrate in good condition with no delamination detected.

title: Inspection Complete — Blasting Authorised
description: Hull inspection report complete. Six sacrificial zincs depleted and replaced. Shaft seal checked and serviceable. No osmotic blistering found. Pre-blast photo record logged. Proceeding with wet blasting as agreed.

title: Hull Blasting and Surface Preparation Complete
description: Wet blasting completed on all underwater surfaces including keel and rudder. Surface grade Sa2.5 achieved. Waterline tape applied. Hull allowed to dry overnight before primer application. Photo documentation attached.

title: Photo Documentation — Post Blast and Primer
description: Photographs taken of blasted hull port, starboard, keel and rudder sections (ref: IMG-SR9004-006 through -009). Surface finish uniform with no holidays confirmed. Primer coat 1 applied at 16:30 — 12-hour cure time required.

title: Antifouling Application 30% Complete
description: Hempel Antifouling Classic first coat applied to starboard side and keel section. Second coat to follow at 6-hour intervals. Hempel Classic Racing Blue topcoat on order from supplier — ETA tomorrow morning.

title: Arrived at Kalamış Marina
description: Team arrived at berth K-12. Kalamış Runner engine room secured and access confirmed. Initial assessment validates shaft vibration as reported by owner.

title: Shaft and Bearing Work Started
description: Propeller shaft removed and placed in lathe for run-out check — within tolerance at 0.02mm. Cutless bearing extracted and found worn beyond acceptable limits. Intermediate bearing also replaced as precautionary measure per standard practice.

title: Additional Corrosion Found in Engine Mounts — Scope Expansion
description: During disassembly, significant electrolytic corrosion found on engine mount studs — not detectable in original inspection without shaft removal. All 4 mounts required full replacement (stainless M16 studs and rubber isolation mounts). Additional 17 hours beyond quoted scope. Contact attempted at 14:02 and 16:31 on 18 June — no response. Proceeded to prevent further shaft misalignment damage.

title: Work Complete — Dispute in Progress
description: All shaft, bearing and engine mount work completed. Sea trial conducted 5 June — no vibration, shaft alignment within specification. Final invoice raised for 47 hours total. Owner has filed platform dispute (ID 9901) contesting the additional hours. Awaiting admin arbitration.
